After [ Bag's Universe ] is released, the enemy takes Dagger DMG equal to 2% of Max HP (not exceeding 20 times the protagonist's ATK). Triggers up to 3 times per round.
artifacts.awaken_base_effect: Deals 35% Dagger DMG 10 times and adds random additional Daggers. Each hit has a 50% chance to inflict a Curse effect that deals continuous damage and reduces the enemy's Shield Bonus.

artifacts.base_effect: Holy Sword Judgment — Every 6 skill triggers, release [ Holy Sword Verdict ], dealing skill damage equal to 750% of the hero's Attack. For every 1% of enemy HP lost, [ Holy Sword Verdict ] damage increases by 1%. Each cast also deals additional skill damage equal to 5% of the enemy's max HP (up to 50x the hero's Attack). Can trigger up to 4 times per round.

When the Imperial Demon Dragon is deployed, the protagonist transforms into the Supreme Dragon God, and [ Ultimate · Final Annihilation Slash ] additionally deals skill damage equal to 6% of the enemy's max HP, capped at 60x the protagonist's ATK.

artifacts.base_effect: Abyssal Bite — After every 4 Basic Attacks, the Abyssal Devourer casts [ Abyssal Bite ], dealing Combo DMG equal to 750% of the Protagonist's ATK to the enemy and inflicting 1 stack of [ Abyssal Rift ], lasting until the end of the battle. Abyssal Rift: Each stack of [ Abyssal Rift ] reduces the enemy's Final Basic Attack DMG Reduction by -1% and Ignore Combo Rate by -0.5%. When hit by the Protagonist's Basic Attack, each stack of [ Abyssal Rift ] causes the enemy to take Combo DMG equal to 1.5% of Max HP, not exceeding 15 times the Protagonist's ATK. [ Abyssal Rift ] stacks up to 5 times.
artifacts.awaken_base_effect: Abyssal Rift Beam — Unable to suppress the Power of the Abyss, the Abyssal Devourer unleashes the [ Abyssal Rift Beam ], dealing 3 instances of Combo DMG equal to 150% of the Artifact's ATK to the enemy, granting the Protagonist [ Power of the Abyss ] for 1 round and 1 stack of [Breath of the Abyss]. Power of the Abyss: Protagonist's Final Combo DMG +5%, Combo count +1. The increased Combo count cannot stack with other Artifacts or Mounts. Breath of the Abyss: Upon taking a single instance of Skill DMG greater than 10% of the Protagonist's Max HP, removes [ Breath of the Abyss ], reduces this damage by 30%, and reduces the enemy's Shield Bonus by -30% for 3 rounds.
